2.reason: The difference between two readings is the number of bytes received within the window; only RTP payload is counted, RTP headers and padding are counted separately in headerBytesReceived, excluding IP/UDP headers.

3.name: jitterBufferDelay
3.cumulative: cumulative (sum; the average must be divided by jitterBufferEmittedCount)
3.quote: It is the sum of the time, in seconds, each audio sample or a video frame takes from the time the first packet is received by the jitter buffer (ingest timestamp) to the time it exits the jitter buffer (emit timestamp).
3.reason: It measures the dwell time of samples or frames in the receiver-side jitter buffer, which is application-layer buffering, not queuing delay on the network path; the specification has no network queuing delay field. It is listed only because its name and unit are the most similar.

4.name: roundTripTime
4.cumulative: instantaneous (value computed from the most recent RTCP RR)
4.quote: Estimated round trip time for this SSRC based on the RTCP timestamps in the RTCP Receiver Report (RR) and measured in seconds.
4.reason: It is the round-trip time rather than the one-way delay, computed from the timestamps of RTCP RR, and does not include clock offset. The mean can be obtained by dividing totalRoundTripTime by roundTripTimeMeasurements; RTCIceCandidatePairStats.currentRoundTripTime is the STUN-based round-trip time.
